forwarder_said: "Please cancel the furniture booking, our client moved it to sea freight."
message_to_send: Dear Sara, thank you for letting us know. We have noted your request to cancel booking B-07 (6 pieces of furniture, 1,800 kg) on FCA 201. The controller will confirm the cancellation. Kind regards, Falcon Cargo Air capacity team.
why: Forwarder cancelled the full booking in writing, so release all 1,800 kg and 14.0 m3 (Space 3.1, 5.2); the app handles fees and re-offers. Sources: booking B-07, forwarder F-04, message M-08, Space 3.1, Space 3.3, Space 5.2.
